trends.name: Iran-Qatar Energy Conflict Escalates
trends.summary: Iranian missile strikes on Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG facility (world's largest, ~20% global supply) caused extensive damage and fires. Trump signals halt to further strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure. Oil jumped 4% amid supply disruption concerns and energy price inflation fears.

trends.name: Fed Holds Rates; Powell Signals No Rescue Plan
trends.summary: Fed maintained rates at 3.75% and warned of uncertain inflation impacts from Iran war. Powell's clearest statement on staying at Fed despite leadership shifts; market interpreted as 'no rush to rescue' equities. Dow fell ~800 points on this hawkish signal.

trends.name: Memorial Sector Weakness & Consumer Slowdown Fears
trends.summary: Five Below surged 15% comparable sales on upbeat holiday outlook, easing consumer slowdown fears. However, broader sentiment suggests market fragility with discretionary spending uncertainty. Starbucks turnaround plans questioned for younger demographics amid social media erosion of teen spending.

trends.name: Semiconductor & Memory Chip Boom
trends.summary: Micron revenue nearly tripled and topped estimates on surging memory demand; Lumentum's bullish revenue forecast fuels AI chip sector momentum. Both stocks among market's hottest performers, signaling sustained semiconductor cycle strength.

trends.name: Drone Sector Fervent Demand Surge
trends.summary: Swarmer stock surged ~1,100% in two days on fervent drone demand. Concurrent drone attack on Iraqi naval base signals geopolitical drone proliferation. Market showing extreme speculative interest in emerging drone technology and defense applications.

trends.name: Private Credit Redemption Crisis Signals
trends.summary: Private-credit fund holding billions in consumer/small-business loans faced mass redemptions this month, cashing out only fraction of requested amounts. Capital Southwest demonstrating resilience amid broader sector concerns. Signal of potential liquidity stress in private credit markets.

trends.name: Streaming & Content M&A Reshaping Competition
trends.summary: Netflix more likely to raise prices post-Warner Bros. deal completion. Signals consolidation in streaming/content sectors and reduced competitive pressure allowing pricing power. Strategic M&A reshaping media landscape and investor returns.

trends.name: China Consumer Engagement & Pop Culture Exports
trends.summary: Pop Mart expanding Labubi toy franchise with movie; China leveraging OpenClaw platform to reach diverse demographics from gearheads to grandmas. Signals Chinese consumer tech/entertainment soft power growth and new monetization avenues.

trends.name: Market Technical Support Breakdown Risk
trends.summary: U.S. stocks reached critical technical support line; analysts warn next move could trigger 10% drop. ZeroHedge signals 'cracks forming' in market pressure at key support levels. Morgan Stanley Risk Signal turned positive exiting risk-off since Feb 27, but fragility remains.

trends.name: Energy Infrastructure & Oil Price Volatility
trends.summary: Oil jumped 4%; prediction markets show gas prices climbing to ~$4.30/gallon (up $0.80 this month). Iran war and Qatar LNG damage creating dual supply shock and inflation catalyst. Energy sector gaining geopolitical premium.

trends.name: Global Growth Slowdown Signals from Data
trends.summary: New Zealand Q4 GDP missed estimates (1.3% Y/Y vs 1.7% poll); Q/Q fell to 0.2% vs 0.5% expected. Brazil cut rates to 14.75% amid war uncertainty. Data suggests cooling global growth despite inflation concerns.

trends.name: Disney Leadership Transformation Under D'Amaro
trends.summary: Lightshed analyst calls for 'radical change' at Disney under new CEO Josh D'Amaro, signaling market expectations for significant strategic restructuring. Reflects investor concerns about Disney's competitive positioning in streaming and content.
